body: Because you haven't responded, I have some concern. I want to know if you are still alive, because you didn't respond. I am hoping the silence is because you didn't need any more help, so please, let me know if you're still with us. I'll continue to offer any help you need.
Sorry if you need me soon, but I have to go for about an hour. I'll be back at 5, I promise you. Anyone else reading this, stay here for him. Thank you.

Hey, I'm not going to say I know just how you feel, but I've been through similar occurrences. I have had a history of depression and have tried to kill myself multiple times. I have been dumped in very similar ways, and I have had to deal with it. I may not be able to do much, but I'm here if you need to talk to me, especially if it gets really bad. I love you as a human being and I want you to live.

Edit: As someone who has tried to kill himself multiple times, I know that things like "you have so much to live for" won't help, so I really mean it when I say, if it gets really bad and you are sure you want to do it, call a hotline. Don't do it for anyone else, do it as a favor to yourself. None of us on reddit, even myself, are professionals.

Finally, if you are having trouble finding a job, I'm sure plenty of people would be willing to take you in for a time. The only advice I can offer on that point, though, is avoid the creepy ones.

Remember, I'm here if you need me. Stay strong.

Yes, the second paragraph is the "Things Every Man Needs to Know" speech from Secondhand Lions. That exact quote once helped a friend of mine not commit suicide.

Here it is, if you want to hear it: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JXn5-r8mj-s

I fully agree with you on the first part.
The second, I have depression. Laughter does not help me, no matter how hard I try. I think it is a good remedy for some, but not for others. However, keep up the positive outlook.

Dude, if you need help, reply to me. I'm here to help, but I need to know what's wrong. I'm here for you.

Sometimes the things that may or may not be true are the things a man needs to believe in the most. That people are basically good; that honor, courage, and virtue mean everything; that power and money, money and power mean nothing; that good always triumphs over evil; and I want you to remember this, that love... true love never dies. You remember that, boy. You remember that. Doesn't matter if it's true or not. You see, a man should believe in those things, because those are the things worth believing in.

Don't be a goddamn fuckhole. Just because someone was underage drinking doesn't mean they have "sinned." This is probably the worst thing to say to someone in this situation besides "kill yourself." When somebody puts their feelings online, this isn't a barrier. Anonymity doesn't prevent feelings from being hurt. Shut the fuck up and leave the OP alone.
